# fct_intake_form_responses

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_intake_form_responses` · dbt area: `portal`

Fact table for individual intake form response submissions with field-level detail. Each row represents a single client response to an intake form (one row per client per intake form). Includes all individual field responses for both v1 and v2 forms, pages included in the form design, and pages completed by the client. Sourced from the Portal database.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `addresses` | JSON array of client addresses. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `advisor_id` | Foreign Key. The User ID of the Advisor who created the intake form. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `allergies_and_diet` | JSON array of allergy and dietary restriction information. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `additional_details` | JSON array of additional trip preferences (e.g., DIETARY_RESTRICTIONS, YOUNG_CHILDREN, LGBTQ, ACCESSIBILITY). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `adult_count` | Number of adults on the trip. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `child_ages` | JSON array of ages for children traveling. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `child_count` | Number of children on the trip. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `client_id` | Foreign Key. The unique identifier for the Contact who submitted this response. Differs from form_client_id, which is the client_id associated with the intake form itself (null for generic forms). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `completed_at` | Timestamp when the client completed the intake form. Null if not yet completed. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `credit_cards` | JSON array of credit card information. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `dates` | JSON array of important dates like birthdays. >> SOURCE - Portal |

| `version` | Intake form version (e.g., 'intake_form_v1', 'intake_form_v2'). Compared to v1, v2 introduces new fields and pages as well as generic/public form functionality. >> SOURCE - Portal |
